tools.name: preview_app
tools.description: Read-only ASO snapshot of any App Store app (grade, lead rank, top-10 count, sample). No account or store push — the optimized copy + push commands stay behind the human-approved loop. Works without a key.

tools.name: audit_app
tools.description: Read-only listing audit: prioritized findings (severity + impact) plus a summary, derived from the live public listing. Read-only — never edits or pushes.

tools.name: audit_play_app_owner
tools.description: Read-only audit of YOUR OWN Google Play app via the official Play Developer API — full fidelity including the short description (which the public page can't show), with NO capability locks. Requires a configured Play service account (GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT). Reads only — it opens and DISCARDS a

tools.name: keyword_gaps
tools.description: Read-only keyword opportunities: terms tracked competitors VISIBLY use that this app doesn't target and doesn't rank top-50 for, sorted by winnability. Inferred from competitor name/subtitle only — never their ranking algorithm.

tools.name: rank_check
tools.description: Read-only organic rank check across the app's target keywords, plus winnability-ranked opportunities computed from those measured positions. Positions are live-measured, never fabricated.

tools.name: screenshot_coverage
tools.description: Read-only screenshot scoring for the app's live store gallery (count, score, grade, levers to improve). Read-only — never uploads or pushes assets.

tools.name: competitor_watch
tools.description: Read-only competitor diff: resolves the named competitors and reports their current listings, what changed vs. the last seen state, and a digest line. Read-only metadata comparison; no ranking-algorithm data is invented.

tools.name: war_room
tools.description: Read-only head-to-head rank war room for one of YOUR connected apps: your tracked-keyword rank history vs. live competitor positions on those same keywords. Reads stored data + live competitor ranks; writes nothing.

tools.name: localization_gaps
tools.description: Read-only localization expansion recommendations (ROI-sorted locales to add) for one of YOUR connected apps, from its most recent App Store Connect run. A static, bundled heuristic over the locales already read — no live install data is fabricated. Empty until you've run an ASC-connected pass.

tools.name: proof
tools.description: Read-only, anonymized aggregate proof across all tracked apps (real rank-win numbers — no app names, no user data). This is the 'prove the rank moved' surface that closes the prepare → approve → push → prove loop. Works without a key.

tools.name: propose_copy
tools.description: Returns a DRAFT optimized listing (name/subtitle/keywords/description) with validation for any app. THIS IS A DRAFT ONLY: it does NOT persist a proposal and does NOT push to the App Store. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_play_app · Public sink: audit_play_app_owner · Destructive: localization_gaps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_play_app · Public sink: audit_play_app_owner · Destructive: localization_gaps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
